title: Move widget spec to wiki once inplemented
body: While working on the widget it's good to iterate fast. But then, we need to keep them up to date and revisionned so might as well to a wiki for those

comments.body:
Yes for this workflow:
- while in heavy dev mode (prototype), using issues is ok since we are going to FIX them
- when released or implemented, then move to wiki
- every API enhancement change should still be an issue then translated to a wiki change
Wiki is the readme for now, and will be the live documentation afterwards.
